notes.title: Kickstarter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470905/e1ceb1f00bd7157eb4c66dee882d55c5d067651a.png[/img]

[b]Hello Neospace friends![/b]

We are still a small indie studio which finances all costs completely by ourselves, as it will be more and more in the long run we will start a Kickstarter soon.


Since it is very important to us to offer you something, we have worked on it for a very long time and, among other things, created the spaceship from the trailer as a complete clamp building block set including building instructions especially for the Kickstarter, we have of course done many other things. You can see more on the Kickstarter when it starts.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dreamstudios/neospace-the-beginning][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470905/1d6bc4f24f686b53bfce1eafe9f0851d5d95e0c3.png[/img][/url]

Of course, this is all voluntary, but we would be very happy about your support!

Go to the link and save the Kickstarter so you don't miss it 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dreamstudios/neospace-the-beginning]Click here to go to kickstarter[/url]


If you would like to support us in any other way, you can do so by showing the Kickstarter and the game Neospace to your friends!

[i]Thank you for your support!
Dreamstudio[/i]

notes.title: Hacker Game
notes.content:
[b]Hey dear Neospace friends,[/b]

It's time! You have often pointed out that the [u]jump-and-run[/u] element is disturbing. Therefore, in Update 1.6.0, which will be the last update, we have introduced a completely new hacker game.

We are very excited about your feedback! [u]A small note: the new hacking game will become more difficult depending on the level of difficulty.[/u]

The next highlight will be our Kickstarter campaign, which we will present to you shortly. Don't forget to add the main game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3098480/Neospace/]wishlist![/url]

[b]Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] New Hacker Game
[*] The building block set model in the hub caused lags, this has been fixed.
[*] "Chip" had translation errors in the hub, these have been fixed.
[/list]

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue.
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Decoration
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

It's that time again we have reached another milestone the version 1.5.0 is now available for you, with this update we want to bring even more details, effects and much more into the game.

The next update will be developed now, where we will throw out the hacking game “Jumpandrun” completely and make a worthy hacker game, we are very excited about your feedback.

The 1.6.0 Update Hacker Game will also be the last major patch for Neospace Prologue. Of course we will continue to fix bugs and other things.

After that we will focus on our Kickstarter and Chapter 1 and you can check out the full version of Neospace Wishlists.

[b]Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] New setting “Bloom” with which you can now greatly reduce the lights
[*] New effects have been added to the main menu
[*] New effects have been added to the Prolouge
[*] Voices have been edited with effects
[*] Asteroid Shooting Achiement has been rewritten because it was often misunderstood that the achivment is NOT done in Spaceship Racer, but in another mini game that can be found in the hub
[*] Cutscene at the end of the Prologue has been reworked
[*] Mouse pointer now has a new design
[*] New syncro has been added in the hub
[*] Collecting trading cards now has an icon
[*] Pick up trading cards sound was added
[*] Minor graphic adjustments
[/list]

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Quality of life
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

Finally version 1.4.0 is the first update from our roadmap and as promised we have fixed a lot of things you told us about to give you a better game experience.

We will of course make further hotfixes if you let us know via our F1 tool ingame.

We will now go straight to the 1.5 update where the roadmap details what you can expect there are visual improvements, new effects, reworked voice acting and much more.

[b]Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] selection menu (Q) now has an effect so that you can see what you have selected.
[*] An additional field has been added to the Terminal Tips password so that you can see how many tips you can still pick up in each case
[*] Interaction system now only marks in green what you can currently use and hides everything you have already used
[*] Subtitle setting error would be fixed
[*] A new app for the tablet has been added so that you can now take notes
[*] You are now asked at the beginning what difficulty you want to play the game on
[/list]

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.6
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We are now almost finished with the first update from the roadmap, but we have received a few bugs that we have now fixed for you.

[b]Changelog[/b]

-Main menu new graphics added for the main version of Neospace

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.5
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We are still in the first major update of the roadmap, but as with the last patch, new things have been reported through the F1 tool and of course we have fixed these things for you directly

[b]Changelog[/b]

-Chip no longer speaks through walls and ceilings in the hub
-The key card had motion blur when moving quickly, this has now been removed
-If you turn off the blur and start it again after completing the prologue, the setting resets this has now been fixed

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.4
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We are currently working on the first major update for Neospace: Prologue, but as we have received some game bugs via our [b]F1 Tool[/b] we wanted to fix them for you as soon as possible.

[b]Changelog[/b]

-In the hub, the prolouge level progress bar was not always displayed correctly
-In the subtitle, the "he" was always left off the wrench
-Wrapping error in the texts
-spaceship racer page ratios at different resolution has been fixed
-Audio slider on tablet now does not start in the middle of recording

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.3
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

We have received even more bugs in the last 2 days through [u]our F1 tool[/u] so today's patch will be a bit bigger. We also have a lot more things that will improve the game and that you have requested, we will put these [u]into 2 bigger updates[/u], these are the updates you can see on the [u]roadmap[/u].

[b]Changelog[/b]

-Man was stuck in 2 places in the hub
-All reported spelling mistakes have been fixed
-In the hub, "Chip" now speaks louder and has a larger radius
-The dubbing voices often did not match the text, this has been fixed
-One dialog was missing in English
-Hologram now stands in front of who is speaking something
-Audio Disk 5 now shows the names of the characters before the sentences
-In the hub of the asteroid minigame the shot would be adjusted so it should be easier to hit (don't want to make it too easy either)

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2
notes.content:
[b]Dear Neospace friends[/b]

As promised last time, we have now taken [u]your feedback[/u] from the ratings and the [u]F1 Tool[/u] and made another hotfix out of it.

[b]Changelog[/b]

[i]-Screw key is written in English that you have to turn it in, but you have to turn it out, this would now be translated differently
-Help system, which is in the right corner, would be renamed to interaction system
-The initial screen "Press a Button to Start..." is now easier to read
-In the hub, the water drip sounds would be made quieter and fixed so that you can no longer hear it on the floor above[/i]

We thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Hey dear Neospace friends![/b]

We have received [u]your feedback[/u], which you have diligently shared with us in the Steam reviews, in our built-in [u]F1 tool[/u] and in the numerous livestreams. We will now fix these in [u]regular updates[/u].

[b]Changelog[/b]

[i]-The spaceship at the beginning disappears from time to time
-Password terminal you can no longer enter infinite numbers if you enter 15 numbers now comes an error and the numbers are reset
-Secret Achievement spelling error fixed[/i]

We would like to thank you and wish you continued enjoyment with Neospace Prologue
Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios CEO

notes.title: Giveaway
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear Neospace friends[/b].

First of all I would like to thank you all for your honest and [u]good feedback[/u] this really helps us a lot to improve the game and makes us as developers very happy.
Of course we have compiled a list from your feedback, especially the recent feedback from [b]@Soul98111[/b]. The [u]community[/u] is our number one priority, as it should be. We will now use this month and [u]next month[/u] to incorporate your ideas and [u]feedback[/u] into the game.

But that's not all, we have put together a [u]cool event[/u] for you and spared no expense or effort to offer you something cool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470905/5cddd4ff55895c8207d047706dfa1fb68e5b8b50.png[/img]

You can win [u]several prizes[/u] by leaving a [u]Steam review[/u], we don't care if it's positive or filled with criticism and negative reviews. [u]Every support counts[/u] and is highly appreciated.
[b]The competition runs until 23.06.2024[/b], the winners will be announced in our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/dreamstudiosde]Livestream on Twitch[/url] and here on Steam. We have also put together a graphic for you in which you can read everything again as well as the prizes, which are really impressive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470905/4cbe82ce1a6b04a90f7ea86e018089a904c42ff8.jpg[/img]

We have really put a lot of time into the development of this [u]terminal block set[/u], this includes a [u]construction manual[/u], which comes as a PDF and a [u]certificate[/u]with the [u]signature[/u] of the [u]developer[/u]

We look forward to everyone taking part and are very excited to see how this goes down with you

And with that, have fun with the puzzle
Robin Hoffmann
